g.text: Delivery speed: from the push to prod (new steps in bold)
Functional Testing on H at once (verdict + video)
CI and FT run side by side;
both must hold for the same H
enqueue H (expected head H, squash; only non-failing PRs merge)
Build on the merge group (H on top of master and the PRs ahead)
master normally moves to the tested commit C
a group run with head exactly C exists: carry its packages and build-version, skip the rebuild
deploy R to tdd (with its acceptance tests)
settle: R carries C, item in Release Queue
train: newest qualifying release for uat is R (older ones superseded)
create deployment R to uat; answer Sign-off
Smoke test runbook on uat for R (during the settle)
create deployment R to prod; answer Sign-off
